examples.title: Inventory for a workshop
examples.prompt: I need an inventory system for my workshop: supply tracking, production recipes per product, low-stock alerts and a dashboard with monthly consumption.

examples.title: Customer portal

hero.kindLabel: What do you want to build?

categories.title: Any digital solution, no catalog limits
categories.description: These are the most common ones. If your idea doesn't fit any, just describe it: the AI will find the best way to solve it.

process.title: From idea to product, with a team of specialized agents
process.description: We don't use a single generic AI. Six agents with defined roles work in sequence, and you approve every important step.

steps.name: Consultant
steps.title: Understands your idea
steps.text: Analyzes your request, spots needs you didn't mention and asks only the necessary questions.

steps.name: Architect
steps.title: Turns it into a specification
steps.text: Goals, modules, roles, data model, integrations, security and acceptance criteria.

steps.name: Designer
steps.title: Designs the experience
steps.text: Design system, responsive interfaces and navigable prototypes to validate before building.

steps.name: Developer
steps.title: Builds the product
steps.text: Frontend, backend, database, APIs and authentication in an isolated environment for your project.

steps.name: QA
steps.title: Verifies it works
steps.text: Functional tests, flows, permissions and responsive checks. Nothing is done until it's verified.

steps.name: Deployment
steps.title: Publishes and maintains it
steps.text: Production, domain, backups and versions. Operations with cost require your authorization.

benefits.title: A development studio, not a template

items.title: Real execution
items.text: The AI doesn't just propose: it writes, runs and tests the code in per-project isolated environments.

items.title: You stay in control
items.text: You approve the scope, the budget and every deployment. Nothing that costs money happens without your authorization.

items.title: Evolves with you
items.text: Ask for a change in plain language and the system extends what already works without rebuilding it.

items.title: Full transparency
items.text: Decision history, status of every task and clear budgets before starting.

items.title: Your product, your infrastructure
items.text: Keep your solution on our platform or take it with you: the code is yours.

items.title: Security by design
items.text: Data separated per customer, role-based permissions, encrypted secrets and activity logs.

useCases.title: Built for companies that need tailored software

items.text: Wholesale catalogs, order portals, per-customer price lists and invoicing integration.
Supply inventory, recipes, batch traceability and quality control.
CRM, quotes, scheduling, customer portals and follow-up automation.
Functional MVPs with authentication, subscriptions, admin panels and analytics.

pricing.title: Three models, transparent budget
pricing.description: Before any development you receive a proposal with scope, timeline and price. Nothing starts without your approval.
pricing.footnote: Plus: optional subscription for hosting, maintenance and evolution of your product on our infrastructure.

items.q: Does the AI really build the software or just generate code in a chat?
items.a: It builds. Each project has its own isolated environment where the agents write, run and test the code. You see a real preview and can request changes on top of what already works.
It depends on scope. After the initial conversation you receive a proposal with features, estimated time and price. No paid work starts without your approval.

items.q: What if my idea doesn't fit any category?
items.a: Categories are just a guide. Describe the problem in your own words and the AI consultant will propose the most suitable solution.
Yes. From the workspace you write, for example, "I want to add a suppliers module" and the system analyzes your project, plans the change and executes it.
You do. You can keep your product on our infrastructure with a subscription or take it with you.

items.q: What if something can't be automated?
items.a: The platform identifies it and requests human intervention. It never marks something as done if it hasn't been verified.
